call_points.text: No FY27 revenue or margin number; management declined to give growth numbers.
Anode plant of 200 MTPA commissioned on 23 April 2026; large-scale anode capex to be announced soon.
Anthraquinone and carbazole project expected to commission in Q2 FY27.
Export footprint rose to 61 countries from 56, helped by China Plus One and European cost structures.
EBITDA per tonne averaged around ₹17,000 across the portfolio; speciality carbon black is significantly higher.
Gross margin expansion is sustainable, from yield, efficiency and waste recovery, not inventory gains.
Net cash of ₹121 Cr at 31 March 2026; future expansion to be funded mainly from internal accruals.
Forex hedging caused losses this year; management will keep positions open as imports and exports are near parity.

operating_notes.text: First anode material facility at Mahistikry, Hooghly, West Bengal, started with 200 MTPA initial installed capacity, part of a phased 200,000 MT annual LiB components plan first communicated on 6 December 2023.
The anode process is designed to accept alternative raw material feeds, which the company links to scalability.
FY26 other expenses included a net forex loss of ₹43.56 Cr for the year and ₹38.13 Cr for Q4FY26.
The new Others segment (mining and other business) contributed ₹274.46 Cr of FY26 revenue and ₹27.80 Cr of segment result.
Birla Tyres Limited became a wholly owned subsidiary on 7 April 2025 and is consolidated from 1 April 2025.
FY26 total Carbon Black capacity is 250,000 MTPA, of which 130,000 MTPA is Speciality Carbon Black, at the Mahistikry single site.
First anode material facility at Mahistikry has an initial capacity of 200 MTPA, using in-house high-purity coal tar pitch.
Birla Tyres' distribution network grew to 43 distributors and over 1,000 dealers in FY26.
Speciality carbon black capacity is 130,000 MTPA and total carbon black 250,000 MTPA after the 70,000 MTPA addition at Mahistikry.
Coal-tar pitch distillation capacity debottlenecked to 600,000 MTPA; 100,000 tonnes new capacity by FY28 to yield 50,000 tonnes of coal tar pitch for export.
EBITDA per tonne averaged around ₹17,000 across the portfolio, with speciality carbon black significantly higher.
Cumulative holdings in Sicona reached 1,67,53,000 Compulsorily Convertible Notes.
Coal tar pitch domestic market share over 65%; coal tar distillation capacity 600,000 MTPA at a single location.
Speciality carbon black capacity 250,000 MT including 130,000 MT speciality, across more than 70 grades.
Birla Tyres distribution spans 49 distributors and over 1,000 dealers; target ₹3,000 Cr top line in 4-5 years.
H1FY27 inventory build-up of ₹331.21 Cr impacted operating cash flows.
Sicona Battery Technologies completed 100% acquisition of Advano (USA), adding silicon anode IP and a US pilot plant.
Sicona secured AUD 45 million in funding from ARENA for silicon-carbon anode commercialisation.
Himadri operates eight zero-liquid-discharge manufacturing facilities and meets 100% of electrical energy needs through in-house clean power.

timeline.summary: Himadri Speciality Chemical Limited scheduled an earnings conference call for Q4 & FY2026 results on April 27, 2026, at 04:00 PM IST with CMD & CEO Anurag Choudhary, EVP Somesh Satnalika, and CFO Kamlesh Agarwal.

On 23 April 2026, Himadri commenced operations at its first anode material facility at Mahistikry, Hooghly, West Bengal, with 200 MTPA initial capacity, part of a phased 200,000 MT LiB components plan announced in December 2023.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,287.76 Cr (+13.5% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹200.79 Cr.
Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹0.80 per equity share (80% face value) for FY2025-26, pending AGM approval on 23 April 2026.

Himadri reported FY26 consolidated EBITDA of ₹1,006 Cr (+19%), PBT ₹1,001 Cr and PAT ₹755 Cr (+36%), and commenced a 70,000 MTPA speciality carbon black line and its first 200 MTPA anode plant at Mahistikry.

On 27 April 2026, Himadri's Q4/FY26 earnings call guided to FY28 PAT of ₹1,100 Cr+ (double FY25's ₹555 Cr), a ₹1,125 Cr 40,000 MTPA LFP Phase 1 with first 2,000 MTPA by Q3FY27, and Birla Tyres revenue of around ₹3,000 Cr in four years from ₹187 Cr in FY26.
On 13 May 2026, Himadri Speciality Chemical announced that ICRA ESG Ratings revised its ESG rating to Combined Rating 82, Exceptional.
Mr. Anurag Choudhary, on behalf of Himadri Speciality Chemical Ltd’s promoters and Persons Acting in Concert (PAC), declared no undisclosed encumbrance on shares as of 31 March 2026.
Himadri Speciality Chemical invested an additional AUD 2.56 million in Sicona Battery Technologies via Compulsorily Convertible Notes.
Himadri reported H1FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,123 Cr (+43% YoY), EBITDA ₹616 Cr and PAT ₹460 Cr, with Q2FY27 revenue ₹1,691 Cr (+57.93% YoY).
Monika Saraswat (ACS: 29322) uploaded the earnings conference call recording for Q2 FY27, held on 22 October 2026 at 16:00 IST, via the company’s website.
